_about: GitHub labels for the factory (SPEC 10.2, MASTER-PLAN D-20). tools/labels.mjs --seed creates or updates them; --labeler writes .github/labeler.yml from the rules below plus one site:<slug> per sites/<slug>/ and one pack:<type> per types/<type>/. Owner: partition F.

labels.name: type:tooling

labels.name: type:ppc
